title.zh: B500S-83D和电动15混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: B500S-83D prints 5 m vertical and 5 m horizontal. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal.
description.zh: B500S-83D 印垂直 5 m、水平 5 m。电动15印垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。

h1.zh: B500S-83D和电动15混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D and Electric 15 are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW, 380 V, materials sand and small stone 5–16 mm, a short boom that is not a truck placing boom, and 280 kg. Electric 15 prints 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm and 450 kg. The short boom line does not appear on Electric 15.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D 和电动15是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。B500S-83D 印 7.5 kW、380 V、适用材料为砂与小石 5–16 mm、本机短臂架而非车载布料杆，以及 280 kg。电动15印 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、450 kg。短臂架那一行不在电动15上。

heading.en: Where B500S-83D and Electric 15 print different values

body.en: Motor power: B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW; Electric 15 prints 15 kW. Vertical delivery height: B500S-83D prints 5 m; Electric 15 prints 15–20 m. Horizontal delivery distance: B500S-83D prints 5 m; Electric 15 prints 60–80 m. Dimensions: B500S-83D prints 915 × 550 × 550 mm; Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：B500S-83D印 7.5 kW；电动15印 15 kW。垂直输送高度：B500S-83D印 5 m；电动15印 15–20 m。水平输送距离：B500S-83D印 5 m；电动15印 60–80 m。外形尺寸：B500S-83D印 915 × 550 × 550 mm；电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: B500S-83D prints cells that Electric 15 does not: Type Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric; Rated voltage 380 V; Boom line Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom; Applicable materials Sand and small stone, 5–16 mm; Delivery hose Standard. Electric 15 prints cells that B500S-83D does not: Theoretical output 8–10 m³/h; Max. aggregate size 1–3 cm; Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm; Total weight 450 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: B500S-83D有、电动15没有的行：型式 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric；额定电压 380 V；臂架行 Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom；适用材料 Sand and small stone, 5–16 mm；输送胶管 Standard。电动15有、B500S-83D没有的行：理论输送量 8–10 m³/h；最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm；输送管内径 100–125 mm；整机重量 450 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The only catalogue line that uses the word boom is the B500S-83D short-boom note. Open /en/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/ for B500S-83D and /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 目录里使用臂架一词的，是 B500S-83D 的短臂架说明。看B500S-83D请打开 /zh/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/，看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does B500S-83D print the same motor power as Electric 15?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动15的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW. Electric 15 prints 15 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D印 7.5 kW。电动15印 15 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does B500S-83D print the same vertical delivery height as Electric 15?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动15的垂直输送高度一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints 5 m. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D印 5 m。电动15印 15–20 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does B500S-83D print the same horizontal delivery distance as Electric 15?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动15的水平输送距离一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints 5 m. Electric 15 prints 60–80 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D印 5 m。电动15印 60–80 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is type missing on Electric 15?

answer.en: The Electric 15 page does not print that label. B500S-83D prints Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动15这一页没有印这个标题。B500S-83D印的是 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
